title: The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2 Anime Reveals 3rd Promo Video, More Cast
content: The staff for the second television anime season based on Nigojū and Umibōzu 's The Detective Is Already Dead ( Tantei wa Mō, Shindeiru. ) light novel series revealed the anime's third promotional video, more cast members, and October 7 debut on Friday.
author: ANN

title: The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2 Reveals Third Trailer and New Cast, October 7 Premiere
content: The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2 revealed its third main trailer, along with new voice cast members and October 7, 2026 premiere date. Nobuhiko Okamoto joins the cast as Scarlet, one of the Tuners and a character identified as the “Vampire.” Akari Komiyama will voice Mia Whitlock, another member of the Tuners…

title: Hakuhodo Teases New Project in Videos
content: Entertainment company Hakuhodo DY Music & Pictures teased in two videos on Friday that it will announce a new project on September 10 at 7:00 p.m. JST. The company also teased the project with the phrase "That man will return." Hakuhodo DY Music & Pictures also revealed several social media accounts for the project…

title: 'Kanojo no Tomodachi' Reveals Additional Cast, Theme Songs, First Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Jyura 's Kanojo no Tomodachi ( My Girlfriend's Friend ) manga a pair of additional cast, third key visual (pictured), the theme songs, and the first promotional video on Friday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 5 at 1.05 a.m.

title: 'Noragami' Creator Adachitoka Begins New Manga in October 2026
content: Adachitoka , the creator of Noragami ( Noragami: Stray God ), announced on X (formerly Twitter) on Friday that their new manga, titled Yadoya no Oinu-sama ( The Inn's Noble Dog ), will begin serialization in Monthly Shounen Magazine on October 6.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Inherit the Winds Anime Gets Advanced 2-Week Screening in Japanese Theaters Starting on November 13
content: The staff for the original television anime project Inherit the Winds ( Kaze wo Tsugumono ) announced on Friday that the anime will get an advanced two-week screening in Japanese theaters starting on November 13. The advanced screening will center on the protagonist Tachikawa Jinsuke.
author: ANN

title: Medalist Manga Goes on Hiatus
content: The official X/Twitter account for Tsurumaikada 's Olympic ice-skating manga Medalist announced on Friday that the manga will go on hiatus due to "production circumstances." The announcement did not reveal when the manga would resume.
author: ANN

title: As a Reincarnated Aristocrat Season 3 Reveals New Trailer, Visual, Cast, September 27 Premiere
content: As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I’ll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World Season 3 revealed the second key visual and trailer, along with new cast members and a September 27, 2026 premiere date.
